purpose: bounded text search across allowed roots while excluding secret zones.

source.source_text: Purpose: bounded text search across allowed roots while excluding secret zones. Input: roots:string[], query:string, glob?:string, max_results?:1..1000. Output: path,line/range,sanitized snippet. Contract: L1 read_only; scope mac.files.search; target filesystem_roots; timeout 30000ms; cap 512KiB; network none; filesystem read_allowed_roots; deny secret content and redact matches that resemble credentials; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
